title: VTC Events — Meeting — Minutes — Record — payload
description: The secretary or the chair records a meeting's minutes: a record in its room, or the text where it has none. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

roomRecordId.description: Where the minutes are in the meeting's room.

text.description: The minutes themselves, where the meeting has no room. Plain text.
